implementation_revision_binding.required_consistency: Resolved commit must equal the exact delivery SHA supplied in the final handoff and future Primary grant implementation_sha. No floating HEAD or descendant is authorized.
implementation_revision_binding.literal_self_SHA_excluded: A tracked file cannot embed its own containing Git SHA. Supply it after commit in the final handoff; no circular metadata-only commits.

handlers.local_exception: _LocalScientificFailure with exact MAP or CANDIDATE scope
handlers.unexpected_programming_error: Not caught by local handlers or broad Exception suppression; propagates after retained-coverage finalization.

map_local: Invalid physical/preview/curvature domain with immutable original point retained
Failed derivative-method comparison after failed numeric record is appended
Expected numerical linear algebra failure in a map/subsystem audit
candidate_local: Failed Riccati/DARE/gain reproduction after original audit record retained
Expected numerical linear algebra failure in original gain/closed-loop support
global: Changed reviewed HEAD/dirty CT1 source checkout or pinned input metadata
containment_rules: Dispatch originals exactly once in original order. Local map failure advances to the next original role/map; candidate support failure advances to the next original candidate.
Recheck common provenance/native trust before downgrading a producer failure to local status. A common recheck failure escapes immediately.
No substitute state/input/reference/gain or cross-candidate source-result cache. Per-candidate callbacks own their state; only common immutable model objects are shared.

Delayed selected-point closed-loop requests are emitted only after original Riccati audit passes. A failed gain audit blocks dependent closed loops/products/forced response, retaining already-computed independent open-loop/defect observations.
Unknown programming defects are not converted into ordinary unavailability.
Emit all twelve coverage rows, including not executed/invalid/unavailable entries and unknown selected-product denominators.

evidence_encoding.detail_encoding: The closed existing event_data.termination_reason string contains a strict JSON object for each L2B event. Envelope context carries original candidate/map/authority where available. This typed JSON-in-string extension avoids changing the approved scientific schema.
evidence_encoding.unknown_population_rule: planned_selected_records=null, missing_selected_records=null, coverage_unknown=true; all twelve IDs remain present.
evidence_encoding.coverage_json_missing_products: Only missing SELECTED complete endpoints with exact original index/time ranges; repetitions across subsystem/normalization/population are intentional and identified in L2B_SELECTED_COVERAGE. Deliberately omitted exhaustive windows do not enter missing_products.
evidence_encoding.censored_prefix: Retained product is RESOURCE_CENSORED/COMPLETED_PREFIX_ONLY, requested endpoint stays null. It remains a missing selected endpoint; no result backfill.

unchanged_producer_limitations: Some immutable L1 producers collapse specific errors into Outcome. This amendment uses exact common reason codes and rechecks common input/native trust before local containment. Richer producer exception typing would require separately authorized changes outside this allowlist.

qualification.py remains unchanged: genuinely missing causal history can conservatively make local open-loop qualification unavailable. This amendment contains that loss to the affected candidate; relaxing that producer policy is outside scope.

guards.py remains unchanged: macOS RSS/output/time sampling is not a demonstrated hard bound; per-phase budgets below are planning allocations checked at review, not separately enforced interrupt deadlines.

The unchanged CLI performs input/resource preflight before the supervisor starts its timer. Establishing a single whole-command 300s deadline requires separately authorized cli.py/guards.py changes; do not treat the displayed command as ready to execute before that scope is resolved.
